emptyMessage.text: Select an asset and date range to compare OEE sources.

transforms.code:
rows = value or []
if len(rows) == 0 or not hasattr(rows[0], 'keys'):
    return []
priority = ['timestamp','startDate','endDate','assetId','assetPath','modeName','availability','performance','quality','oee','runtimeSecs','unplannedDowntimeSecs','targetCount','infeedCount','wasteCount','durationSecs','error']
first = rows[0]
fields = [f for f in priority if f in first] + [f for f in first.keys() if f not in priority]
cols = []
for f in fields:
    cols.append({
        'field': f,
        'visible': True,
        'editable': False,
        'header': {'title': f},
        'resizable': True,
        'sortable': True,
        'justify': 'left',
        'align': 'center'
    })
return cols
